grades.quote: The 12-bit B-immediate encodes signed offsets in multiples of 2 bytes. The offset is sign-extended and added to the address of the branch instruction to give the target address.
grades.reason: Directly explains RISC-V BEQ target calculation: the branch instruction's address plus the sign-extended encoded offset.
Explains LoongArch BEQZ/BNEZ, whose immediate format and scaling differ from RISC-V BEQ.
